title.value: Model-based graph reinforcement learning for inductive traffic signal control
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Model-based graph reinforcement learning for inductive traffic signal control

extractions.description: The paper introduces a model-based reinforcement learning method, MuJAM, for adaptive traffic signal control. It aims to minimize traffic congestion, which has environmentally and socially harmful outcomes, by enabling explicit coordination at scale and generalizing to the controllers’ constraints.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly states that adaptive-traffic-signal-control (ATSC) aims at minimizing traffic congestion which gives rise to a plethora of environmentally and socially harmful outcomes.
